units.source_text: 他又挑了另一个地方试了一次。

en.t: He chose another spot and tried once more.
It was still the same as before.

units.source_text: 女人曾经说过，沙子让木头腐烂，看来真是事实。

en.t: The woman had once said that sand made wood rot, and it seemed that it really was true.

units.source_text: 这一面的板壁比哪儿光照都好，它尚且如此，其他板壁也就可想而知了。

en.t: This side of the plank wall got better light than anywhere else, and if even this was in such a state, the other walls were easy enough to imagine.

units.source_text: 真亏造得出这种软不拉塌的房子……

en.t: It was amazing they could build such a limp, sagging house...

units.source_text: 就在最近，听说还有用纸和塑料布造的房子呢，所以，软不拉塌，也许有软不拉塌的力学构造吧……

en.t: These days, he had heard, there were even houses made of paper and plastic sheeting, so perhaps limpness had its own limp sort of mechanical structure...
